summary: Verified 60 claims against 14 primary pages (code.claude.com docs, support.claude.com Cowork and Artifacts articles), fetched 2026-11-06. CLI and cloud claims are largely accurate. Corrections: Cowork has no documented plan mode, /compact, /clear, /context, rewind or /memory, but the help page does not say they are absent. Cowork Team web/mobile beta wording is overstated. The Desktop disconnect wait applies to SSH sessions. Auto memory is documented as not shared with cloud environments. Artifacts Output menu is documented for claude.ai chats only. Cloud plan requirements add Enterprise with Chat + Claude Code seats. Still unknown or unverifiable: Desktop /compact, /clear, /memory and rewind; Cowork slash commands and rewind; mobile plan-mode menu path; Cowork Instructions labels; Cowork live-artifact date cutoff; Desktop Cmd-click new window. Missing for the topic: Cowork Auto/Manual/Skip defaults by plan, Dispatch (Pro/Max/Ultra), the Desktop-CLI handoff commands, /btw, /fork, /powerup, and subagents for context hygiene.
